subject.title: feat(memory): add excludePaths option to memorySearch config

question: Should OpenClaw ship a builtin-only public `memorySearch.excludePaths` config key after the mechanical repairs, or wait for QMD and recall-eligibility scope to be designed together?
rationale: The code repairs are narrow, but adding a public config surface that intentionally does nothing for QMD is a product boundary decision.

options.title: Ship builtin-only after repairs
options.body: Repair merge semantics, index identity, and generated docs first, then ship the narrow builtin backend feature with the documented QMD caveat.

options.title: Require QMD parity first
options.body: Hold this PR until the same exclusion semantics are designed and tested for QMD indexing too.

options.title: Fold into broader memory scope
options.body: Pause or supersede this PR in favor of the broader recall/index eligibility design tracked by the related feature issue.

recommendation.title: Ship builtin-only after repairs
recommendation.body: Repair merge semantics, index identity, and generated docs first, then ship the narrow builtin backend feature with the documented QMD caveat.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses memory indexing, config compatibility, and published docs where steipete has the strongest recent ownership trail.
